## Invitations

A total of 1542 people were invited to the River Districts outreach activity. Attendance was 271, representing a rate of 17.6 per cent. The attendance result indicates that participation remained below the number of invitations issued. The figures will support routine review of outreach activity and planning for future contact with invited people.

The invitation process provided an opportunity for people to engage with the service and attend the activity. Attendance information has been recorded for reporting and follow-up purposes. Staff continue to contact people who missed appointments, to support further engagement where appropriate.

## Contact

SMS messages were sent to 1316 invitees. Reminders were also sent to 1316 invitees as part of the contact process. This approach provided a consistent prompt before the activity and supported communication with people who had been invited.

Contact activity and attendance will continue to be monitored through standard reporting arrangements. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
